scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n WEB,SERVER,WORKER "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w agent"
scripts.test: npm run db:ensure && npm run test:prepare -w server && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:prepare -w server && npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:core: npm run db:ensure && npm run test:prepare -w server && npm run test:core -w server
